동생.x: My younger sibling is a high school student.
동생.e: Literally 'same birth'; add 남 or 여 for brother or sister: 남동생, 여동생.

생각.e: 생각하다 = to think; 생각나다 = to come to mind (lit. 'a thought comes out').
생각.t: 생각이 나다 can also mean 'to remember'. 생각해요 = 'I think.'

나쁘다.x: Smoking is bad for your health.
나쁘다.e: 나빠요 (the ㅡ drops). 나쁜 남자 'bad boy' is a classic K-drama type.

양복.ex: 아버지는 매일 양복을 입고 회사에 가세요.
양복.x: My father wears a suit to work every day.
양복.e: Literally 'Western clothes', in contrast to 한복 'Korean clothes'.

파.x: Ramyeon tastes better if you add green onion.
파.e: Homonym warning: 파 also means 'party, faction'; 양파 'onion' is literally 'Western 파'.
파.t: 파전 is a savory green onion pancake, popular on rainy days with makgeolli.

대부분.x: Most students come to school by bus.

잘하다.m: to be good at, to do well; to treat well
잘하다.x: My friend is really good at singing.
잘하다.t: The skill takes 을/를: 한국어를 잘해요. Written as one word, unlike 잘 먹다 or 잘 자다.

아무리.x: No matter how busy I am, I always eat breakfast.
아무리.t: 아무리 almost always teams up with -아도/어도 later in the sentence.

대사관.x: I lost my passport, so I have to go to the embassy.
대사관.e: Literally 'great-envoy building': where the ambassador (대사) works.

차이점.ex: 한국어와 영어의 가장 큰 차이점이 뭐예요?
차이점.x: What's the biggest difference between Korean and English?
차이점.e: Literally 'point of difference'; -점 = point: 장점, 단점, 공통점.

중요성.x: The older I get, the more I feel the importance of health.
중요성.e: Literally 'the quality of being weighty and important'.

꾸미다.m: to decorate; to dress up; to make up (a story)
꾸미다.x: We decorated the house nicely for Christmas.
꾸미다.e: Also means 'to fabricate': 꾸민 이야기 is a made-up story.

직종.ex: 이 직종은 경력이 있는 사람을 원해요.
직종.x: This line of work looks for people with experience.

프랜차이즈.ex: 요즘은 동네에도 프랜차이즈 카페가 정말 많아요.
프랜차이즈.x: These days there are a lot of chain cafes even in neighborhoods.
프랜차이즈.e: From English 'franchise'. In everyday speech Koreans also say 체인점 for a chain store.

관절염.ex: 어머니는 관절염 때문에 계단을 오르기 힘들어하세요.
관절염.x: My mother has a hard time climbing stairs because of arthritis.
관절염.t: Pronounced [관절렴] — an ㄴ sound is added before 염 and becomes ㄹ.

진료비.ex: 보험이 있어서 진료비가 많이 나오지 않았어요.
진료비.x: I have insurance, so the medical bill wasn't much.
진료비.t: Pronounced [질료비] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

복학.m: returning to school (after a leave of absence)
복학.x: After finishing military service, I'll go back to school next year.
복학.t: Pronounced [보칵]; very common for Korean men after military service.

공학.x: He majored in engineering and became an engineer.
공학.t: An engineering school is commonly called 공대, short for 공과 대학.

흡족하다.x: The boss was very pleased with the results this time.
흡족하다.t: Pronounced [흡조카다]; for someone else's feelings, use 흡족해하다.

손이 크다.forms: 손이 커요 · 손이 컸어요 · 손이 큰 사람 (ㅡ drops)
손이 크다.m: to be generous (esp. with food or spending), to do things on a big scale
손이 크다.ex: 할머니는 손이 커서 음식을 항상 많이 만드세요.
손이 크다.x: Grandma is generous, so she always makes lots of food.
손이 크다.t: Not about actual hand size; often said of someone who cooks huge portions.

입증하다.x: He proved his skill through results.
입증하다.t: Pronounced [입쯩하다] — the ㅈ becomes tense after ㅂ.

처하다.m: to be faced with, to be placed in (a situation)
처하다.ex: 그 회사는 지금 큰 위기에 처해 있어요.
처하다.x: That company is now facing a major crisis.
처하다.e: Literally 'to be placed' — being put in a situation.

나뉘다.m: to be divided, to be split up
나뉘다.ex: 그 문제에 대해서 의견이 둘로 나뉘었어요.
나뉘다.x: Opinions were split in two on that issue.
나뉘다.e: Passive of 나누다 'to divide': a shorter way to say 나누어지다.
나뉘다.t: Don't confuse 나뉘어요 'it is divided' with 나눠요 'I divide it'.

맺다.m: to tie (a knot); to form (a relationship), to sign (a contract); to bear (fruit)
맺다.ex: 두 회사는 작년에 새로운 계약을 맺었어요.
맺다.x: The two companies signed a new contract last year.
맺다.e: Probably related to 매듭 'knot': tying things together, literally or socially.
맺다.t: Pronounced [맫따]; common pairs are 관계를 맺다, 계약을 맺다 and 열매를 맺다.

법령.x: The new law takes effect next month.

비꼬다.m: to be sarcastic, to make snide remarks; to twist (rope)
비꼬다.ex: 그렇게 비꼬지 말고 솔직하게 말해 주세요.
비꼬다.x: Don't be so sarcastic—just tell me honestly.
비꼬다.e: Literally 'to twist (rope)' — twisting your words to mock someone.

머리를 굴리다.forms: 머리를 굴려요 · 머리를 굴렸어요 · 머리 좀 굴려 봐
머리를 굴리다.m: to rack one's brain; to think hard (sometimes slyly)
머리를 굴리다.ex: 아무리 머리를 굴려도 좋은 방법이 생각나지 않아요.
머리를 굴리다.x: No matter how hard I rack my brain, I can't think of a good way.
머리를 굴리다.e: Literally 'to roll one's head' — keeping the brain turning.
머리를 굴리다.t: Can sound sly, implying someone is calculating for their own benefit.

바람을 맞다.forms: 바람을 맞아요 · 바람을 맞았어요 · 바람맞히다 (to stand someone up)
바람을 맞다.ex: 한 시간이나 기다렸는데 결국 바람을 맞았어요.
바람을 맞다.x: I waited a whole hour and ended up getting stood up.
바람을 맞다.e: Literally 'to be hit by the wind,' left standing out in the cold.
바람을 맞다.t: The one who fails to show uses 바람맞히다: 그가 나를 바람맞혔어요.

분기점.m: turning point; junction, fork (in a road)
분기점.ex: 그 경기는 그의 선수 생활에서 중요한 분기점이 됐어요.
분기점.x: That game became an important turning point in his career.
분기점.e: Literally 'divide-fork point' — where one road splits into two.
분기점.t: On highways, 분기점 (JC) is an interchange between expressways; homonym 분기 also means 'quarter (of a year)'.

수신료.ex: 한국에서는 전기 요금과 함께 TV 수신료를 내요.
수신료.x: In Korea, you pay the TV license fee together with your electricity bill.
수신료.t: Pronounced [수신뇨] — ㄹ after ㄴ here becomes ㄴ.

책망하다.ex: 그는 스스로를 책망하며 밤새 잠을 못 잤어요.
책망하다.x: He blamed himself and couldn't sleep all night.

승부욕.x: That athlete has a really strong will to win.
승부욕.t: Often a compliment: 승부욕이 강하다 means 'very competitive.'

절제미.ex: 그의 시는 감정을 아끼는 절제미가 돋보입니다.
절제미.x: His poetry stands out for the beauty of holding emotions back.
절제미.e: Literally 'self-control beauty': saying more with less.

소나타.ex: 오늘 연주회에서 베토벤의 피아노 소나타를 들었어요.
소나타.x: At today's concert, I heard a Beethoven piano sonata.

곡학아세.m: twisting scholarship to flatter the powerful
곡학아세.ex: 그 교수는 권력에 아부하는 곡학아세로 비판을 받았어요.
곡학아세.x: That professor was criticized for bending his scholarship to please those in power.
곡학아세.e: Literally 'bend learning to flatter the world.'

알권리.ex: 국민의 알권리를 위해 정보를 공개해야 합니다.
알권리.x: Information must be disclosed for the sake of the public's right to know.
알권리.e: 알 'to know' (modifier form of 알다) + 권리 'right'.
알권리.t: Pronounced [알꿜리]: tensing plus ㄴ becoming ㄹ after ㄹ.
